title: Front controller, router with module route discovery, JSON responses, GET /api/health
acceptance: SPEC 2.4-2.5, 3, 6: php -S serves /api/health -> 200 {success:true,status:ok}; unknown path 404 NOT_FOUND; wrong method 405; errors use {success:false,code,message}; no stack traces in 500s.

title: Config resolver (env > config.local.php > default) and .env.example with placeholders only
acceptance: SPEC 2.2: every key listed has a placeholder in .env.example; .env and config.local.php are gitignored; app never reads .env.

title: PDO layer (mysql|sqlite), schema for ALL modules in both dialects, bin/migrate.php
acceptance: SPEC 4: php bin/migrate.php creates every table on SQLite, idempotent on rerun; db/schema.mysql.sql has the same tables and columns.

title: Seed CLI: --samples (SAMPLE ingredients + 3 SAMPLE recipes) and --fixtures (4 locations, 4 users)
acceptance: SPEC 5.1-5.2: seed --fixtures loads exactly the fixture rows; refuses with exit 1 when APP_ENV=production; --samples is skipped when recipes already exist.

title: Auth: POST /api/login, POST /api/logout, GET /api/me; X-Auth-Token; role = location type
acceptance: SPEC 6: fixture users log in with username+email+password; wrong field -> 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS generic; missing field -> 422; token stored as sha256; expired or logged-out token -> 401.

title: FinCon read-only interface, mock adapter, HTTP adapter (reference tunnel protocol, function allowlist)
acceptance: SPEC 10: interface has only readStock(); mock returns the s10.3 quantities and logs kind=read; HTTP adapter sends CF-Access headers + Basic auth, calls only allowlisted functions, maps 401/403/no-response/non-2xx/ErrorInfo to typed statuses; mock refused in production.

title: Mailer interface with log and PHP mail() transports
acceptance: SPEC 2.2, 11: MAIL_TRANSPORT=log appends one JSON line {to,subject,body} to MAIL_LOG_PATH; mail transport uses mail() like the reference.

title: Test runner, harness, fake FinCon server, smoke test, docs/CORE_API.md, .pipeline/test-cmd.txt
acceptance:
SPEC 2.6: php tests/run.php runs every suite in its own process and ends with 'RESULT:

passed, failed'; smoke test starts a fresh app and gets /api/health 200; test-cmd.txt is the single line 'php tests/run.php'.

title: Black-box acceptance tests A1-A7 under tests/acceptance
acceptance: SPEC 12: one or more test files per check A1-A7, using only the HTTP API, fixtures and s5.3 values; expected to fail until modules are built.

title: Login page, landing page, shared app.js/app.css
acceptance: SPEC 2.4: login.html posts to /api/login, stores the token in sessionStorage, redirects to index.html; app.js adds X-Auth-Token and sends 401s back to login; all rendered text escaped.

title: Hub login verified end to end (location type hub)
acceptance: SPEC 1, 6: hub.user login -> role 'hub', location type 'hub'; hub2.user is a different location; module test proves the role gates below use the token's location, never a request field.

title: GET /api/ingredients - catalogue at cost price
acceptance: SPEC 7.2: hub and hq get active ingredients sorted by sku with cost_price 2 dp; hq ?include_inactive=1 adds inactive; franchise 403.

title: PUT /api/admin/ingredients/{sku} - HQ sets cost prices
acceptance: SPEC 7.3: hq creates (201) and updates (200); validation 422 (negative cost, >2 dp, name/unit length); hub and franchise 403; existing order lines keep their snapshot.

title: GET /api/stock - read-only FinCon stock view with cache and fail-open
acceptance: SPEC 7.1, A7: with the mock, statuses SMP001 in, SMP002 low, SMP003 out, SMP004 in, SMP005 in, SMP006 in; no cost/price keys; hub, hq and franchise get 200; FinCon failure serves cache with stale=true and fincon_status set; never writes to FinCon.

title: POST /api/orders - hub orders ingredients from HQ at cost
acceptance: SPEC 7.4, A3: unit_price = current cost, client prices ignored; s5.3 order totals 125.00 + 300.00 = 425.00; price_basis 'cost'; all 422 cases; sample ingredients rejected when APP_ENV=production; hq and franchise 403.

title: HQ notification for every hub order (email + order_notifications outbox)
acceptance: SPEC 11: one mail to HQ_ORDERS_EMAIL per order with lines, cost and the 'Internal transfer at cost - not a VAT invoice' line; order_notifications row 'sent'; empty HQ_ORDERS_EMAIL or mail failure -> row 'failed', order still 201.

title: Order history: GET /api/orders and GET /api/orders/{id}, location-scoped
acceptance: SPEC 7.5-7.6, A1: hub sees only own orders (location_id param ignored); other location's order -> 404; hq sees all with location_id/status filters; franchise 403.

title: PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status - HQ fulfilment, inventory credit on delivered
acceptance: SPEC 7.7: forward-only transitions, cancelled only from pending/in_process, illegal -> 409; delivered adds +qty inventory_movements (reason order_delivered) exactly once; hub and franchise 403.

title: Ordering UI (public/ordering.html)
acceptance: SPEC 7.8: hub sees stock badges, ingredient list with cost, can place an order and view history; hq sees all orders and can change status; text escaped.

title: CSV ingredient import CLI (bin/import_ingredients.php)
acceptance: SPEC 2.3: upserts sku,name,unit,cost_price,fincon_item_no rows; rejects bad rows with line numbers and imports nothing if any row is invalid.

title: GET /api/recipes and /api/recipes/{id} with cost per unit
acceptance: SPEC 8.1: three SAMPLE recipes with cost_per_unit 5.59, 4.38, 22.66 and per-line costs; unknown id 404; franchise 403.

title: POST/PUT /api/recipes - create and edit recipes
acceptance: SPEC 8.2: create 201, update 200 replaces lines; duplicate finished_sku 409; 422 for empty lines, unknown/inactive sku, qty <= 0 or > 3 dp, duplicate sku; past batches unchanged after edit; franchise 403.

title: POST /api/batches - record a batch, deduct ingredients, cost per item
acceptance: SPEC 8.3, A4: muffin x24 -> deductions 1.440/0.720/0.480/0.360/0.240, total 134.16, cost_per_item 5.59, line costs as s5.3; one transaction; negative on-hand allowed with warnings; hq and franchise 403; 422 for inactive recipe, non-integer qty, future date.

title: GET /api/batches/{id} - location-scoped batch detail
acceptance: SPEC 8.4: hub own batch 200 with snapshot lines; other location's batch 404; hq any; franchise 403.

title: Inventory: GET /api/inventory and POST /api/inventory/adjustments
acceptance: SPEC 8.5-8.6: on_hand = sum of movements per sku, every active ingredient listed; adjustments 201 return new on_hand; hq must give a hub location_id (else 422); hub location_id ignored; franchise 403.

title: Recipes and production UI (public/recipes.html)
acceptance: SPEC 8.7: list recipes with cost per unit, edit a recipe, record a batch and show cost result and warnings, inventory table with adjustment form; text escaped.

title: GET /api/reports/finished-goods - finished goods for HQ (JSON)
acceptance: SPEC 9.1, A5: built from batch snapshots; s5.3 hub report totals 46 / 245.04 / 3, hq report 51 / 358.34 / 4; totals equal sums over items and batches; date filter inclusive; bad dates 422; hub scoped to own; franchise 403.

title: Finished-goods report CSV export (format=csv)
acceptance: SPEC 9.1: text/csv with the exact header row, one row per item and a TOTAL row matching the JSON totals.

title: GET /api/admin/recipes - admin recipe list
acceptance: SPEC 9.2: includes inactive recipes, line_count, cost_per_unit, batch_count, last_produced_on (hub counts own location only); franchise 403.

title: GET /api/admin/batches - admin batch list with filters
acceptance: SPEC 9.3: newest first; from/to/recipe_id filters; hq location_id filter; hub own only; franchise 403.

title: Reports UI (public/reports.html)
acceptance: SPEC 9.4: date-range report with totals and CSV download, admin recipe and batch lists; text escaped.
